app_functionality.purpose: Enables families and funeral coordinators to dynamically select service components (base tier, religious rites, casket upgrades, wake duration/location, ash management, and addons) and calculate real-time pricing breakdowns with prevailing GST.
user_workflow_steps: Select core service tier (Direct Cremation, Standard, Deluxe, Premium)
Select religious or secular ceremony rites
Choose casket upgrades (Standard Eco-wood, Oak, Teak)
Select wake location (HDB Void Deck or Air-Con Parlour) and duration (3, 5, or 7 days)
Select ash management preference (Mandai cremation, CCK inland scattering, Changi sea scattering, columbarium niche, keepsake jewellery)
Select custom logistics and addons (buffet catering, air-cooler tentage, memory video, livestreaming, overnight security guard, premium hearse, floral wreaths, will planning, grief counselling)
Review real-time itemized pricing subtotal, dynamic 9% GST tax addition, and the total quote sum
app_functionality.family_collaboration_features: Allows coordinates to save current configurations, share draft quotes via a digital link, or export details to family messaging groups for collective review and consensus.

app_functionality.purpose: Captures the family representative's electronic signature directly inside the browser using HTML5 Canvas drawing, ensuring legal agreement verification without external third-party dependencies.
user_workflow_steps: Scroll to the authorization section of the generated quote sheet
Use a mouse, trackpad, or touch screen to draw the signature inside the designated canvas box
System draws the strokes live and encodes the drawing as a Base64 text string
Submit the signature to insert the drawing directly into the active quotation document
Quote status is updated instantly to 'Executed and Verified' with name and timestamp
app_functionality.family_collaboration_features: Single signature box for the primary next-of-kin representative, with instant visual confirmation visible to all family members reviewing the screen.

app_functionality.purpose: Generates a clean, professional, single-page PDF quote document for the family, stripping out app navigation panels and UI controls using native CSS print styles.
user_workflow_steps: Click the 'Print Quote' button on the verified quotation panel
System triggers the native browser print dialogue box
CSS media print styles hide active buttons, sidebars, and input fields
The document is formatted as a formal billing layout with the company logo, quote ID, client details, itemized lines, totals, and the embedded e-signature
Save the resulting clean layout directly as a PDF or send it to a local printer
app_functionality.family_collaboration_features: Generates a standardized PDF file that can be immediately emailed, printed, or sent via WhatsApp to all family representatives and executors.

app_functionality.purpose: Logs client leads, records chat conversations, captures intake options, and handles seamless escalation from AI chatbot support to a human funeral director.
user_workflow_steps: Client initiates chat or completes the basic configuration flow
System captures contact details (name, email, phone) and configuration selections in leads.json
If the customer asks out-of-scope questions (e.g. food delivery) or requests a direct consultation, a human director is notified
Marcus Chen (or another assigned consultant) joins the live chat, switching the mode from AI to HUMAN
The intake data and final quote decisions are saved in consultant_requests.json, updating ticket status to IN PROGRESS or RESOLVED
app_functionality.family_collaboration_features: Multi-staff visibility allows backend consultants to review draft calculations and previous chat histories to assist the family consistently.

app_functionality.purpose: Uses AI-guided inputs to help families draft a meaningful tribute biography for the deceased, which is then printed and shared at the wake tables.
user_workflow_steps: Open the 'A Life Well Lived' configuration tab
Complete a short digital questionnaire regarding the deceased's hobbies, achievements, milestones, and favorite memories
The system processes inputs to compile a flowing, respectful biography draft
Approve the draft and export it to a printable tribute layout with background imagery
Place printed cards on wake tables for guests to read and reflect upon
app_functionality.family_collaboration_features: Multiple family members can submit answers to the biography questionnaire, combining their favorite memories into a single, cohesive story.
